axes.model_access: First-party plus aggregated: the product runs Pika 2.5 (image/text-to-video at 480p/720p/1080p, 5/10 s) alongside partner models such as Seedance 2.5, MiniMax H3, GPT Image 2.5, Nano Banana 2.1, Seedream and ElevenLabs/Pika Music/Speech/SFX. Pika API Club claims 100+ video/image/audio models through one API (2026-11-21).
axes.runtime: Web/app at pika.art plus an asynchronous API (`https://api.dev.pika.art`, `X-API-Key` auth); generation runs in the vendor cloud, with API billing separate from product credits (2026-11-21).
axes.local_files: No local model: references arrive as public URLs, or via `POST /v1/media/uploads` for a five-minute presigned upload followed by a permanent Pika CDN URL; finished video sits at `output.video.url`, and `DELETE /v1/media/jobs/{id}` erases the media plus the submitted prompt and parameters (2026-11-21).
axes.background: Async jobs: submission returns `id` and `status=queued`, clients poll `GET /v1/media/jobs/{id}` until completed/failed/cancelled and read the download URL on completion, with webhooks also available. A 429 carries `Retry-After`, and 503 should be retried with backoff (2026-11-21).
axes.tools: Pikaffects (23+ physical effects such as cake-ify, melt, levitate and crystalize), Pikaframes (interpolation across 2–5 stills), Pikadditions, Pikaswaps, Pikastream live sessions, Video/Image/Music/Speech/SFX Studio, Camera Director, Motion Transfer, Extend Video, Relight, Color Grade and Character Studio (2026-11-21).
axes.context: Works are organised in Library/Projects, and characters and elements saved to the Library can be reused across generations (Character Studio produces a character sheet); PikaStream is conversational real-time interaction. Cross-session chat memory is not part of the product, so reuse relies on explicitly saved assets (2026-11-21).
axes.permissions: Free/Starter/Creator/Fancy subscriptions plus credits; paid tiers include commercial rights, Free does not, and current downloads are watermark-free on every tier. Pika may use uploads and creations to improve its services/models, third-party models add their own terms, and API billing is separate and does not consume Pika credits (2026-11-21).
axes.fit: Fit: social short effects (Pikaffects-style), image-to-video, multi-shot clips, reusable character/product consistency and API batch production. Not fit: cinematic long takes, fully offline work or commercial use on the Free tier (2026-11-21).

runs: This entry checks the official FAQ, the Pika 2.5 API reference and the API Club page. Per-effect availability, Free-tier boundaries and character consistency need account-level measurement.
unknowns:
- Open weights: Pika centres on a closed product and API; check the official repository for weight status.
- Current Discord entry and work migration: the official FAQ says the old site is retired and paid works moved to the OG Pika project.
- Training controls: the official privacy policy and terms are the final word.
- Cross-session memory: the product relies on Library/Projects and explicit asset reuse.
related: Both effects-play oriented: PixVerse has a heavier template ecosystem and domestic direct access, Pika's effects line is more single-point.
Both overseas video benches: Runway leans professional film/TV workflows, Pika leans social play.
The domestic alternative for effects play: Jimeng's effects-play line + mainland direct connection works.
